INSERT INTO reconciliation_record (task_id, bill_item_id, result, channel_order_no, merchant_order_no, bill_amount, bill_status, platform_amount, platform_status, platform_order_no, platform_refund_no, remark) SELECT #{taskId}, bi.id, CASE WHEN bi.bill_status = 'REFUNDED' THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(rs.refund_cnt, 0) = 0 THEN 'STATUS_MISMATCH' WHEN bi.amount = rs.refund_total THEN 'MATCHED' ELSE 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH' END WHEN bi.bill_status = 'FAILED' THEN CASE WHEN po.status = 'FAILED' THEN 'MATCHED' ELSE 'STATUS_MISMATCH' END ELSE CASE WHEN bi.amount != po.amount THEN 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH' WHEN po.status IN ('PAID', 'SETTLED') THEN 'MATCHED' ELSE 'STATUS_MISMATCH' END END, bi.channel_order_no, bi.merchant_order_no, bi.amount, bi.bill_status, po.amount, po.status, po.platform_order_no, LEFT(rs.refund_nos, 64), CASE WHEN bi.bill_status = 'REFUNDED' AND IFNULL(rs.refund_cnt, 0) = 0 THEN '状态不一致: 账单 REFUNDED / 平台无成功退款单' WHEN bi.bill_status = 'REFUNDED' AND bi.amount != rs.refund_total THEN CONCAT('金额不一致: 账单 ', bi.amount, ' / 平台退款合计 ', rs.refund_total) WHEN bi.bill_status = 'FAILED' AND po.status != 'FAILED' THEN CONCAT('状态不一致: 账单 FAILED / 平台 ', po.status) WHEN bi.bill_status = 'SUCCESS' AND bi.amount != po.amount THEN CONCAT('金额不一致: 账单 ', bi.amount, ' / 平台 ', po.amount) WHEN bi.bill_status = 'SUCCESS' AND po.status NOT IN ('PAID', 'SETTLED') THEN CONCAT('状态不一致: 账单 SUCCESS / 平台 ', po.status) ELSE NULL END FROM reconciliation_bill_item bi JOIN (SELECT po0.id, po0.merchant_order_no, po0.amount, po0.status, po0.platform_order_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY po0.merchant_order_no ORDER BY po0.id) AS rn FROM payment_order po0) po ON po.merchant_order_no = bi.merchant_order_no AND po.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT ro.order_id, SUM(ro.refund_amount) AS refund_total, COUNT(*) AS refund_cnt, GROUP_CONCAT(ro.refund_no) AS refund_nos FROM refund_order ro WHERE ro.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY ro.order_id) rs ON rs.order_id = po.id WHERE bi.task_id = #{taskId}
UNION ALL
-- 渠道有、平台无 SELECT #{taskId}, bi.id, 'MISSING_IN_PLATFORM', bi.channel_order_no, bi.merchant_order_no, bi.amount, bi.bill_status, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '平台侧无此商户单号' FROM reconciliation_bill_item bi LEFT JOIN payment_order po ON po.merchant_order_no = bi.merchant_order_no WHERE bi.task_id = #{taskId} AND po.id IS NULL
UNION ALL
-- 平台有、渠道无：本渠道当日成功支付单未出现在账单行中 SELECT #{taskId}, NULL, 'MISSING_IN_CHANNEL', (SELECT pt.channel_order_no FROM payment_transaction pt WHERE pt.order_id = po.id AND pt.channel_code = #{channelCode} ORDER BY pt.id LIMIT 1), po.merchant_order_no, NULL, NULL, po.amount, po.status, po.platform_order_no, NULL, '平台当日成功单未出现在渠道账单' FROM payment_order po WHERE po.status IN ('PAID', 'SETTLED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_transaction pt WHERE pt.order_id = po.id AND pt.channel_code = #{channelCode}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_order_state_log sl WHERE sl.order_id = po.id AND sl.to_status = 'PAID' AND DATE(sl.created_at) = #{billDate}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reconciliation_bill_item bi WHERE bi.task_id = #{taskId} AND bi.merchant_order_no = po.merchant_order_no)
